description: The Rask component kit: the chrome, controls, data display and overlays the framework's own surfaces are built from — shell, top bar, breadcrumb switcher, tab bar, buttons, search, status dots, metric rows, detail lists, code blocks, sheets and toasts. Mobile-first, Tailwind v4 only, and no JavaScript but the rich text editor's and the phone field's, which a page loads only when it draws one. An app with a Tailwind build compiles the kit into its one stylesheet with a single import; a precompiled sheet is embedded for a surface without one.
title: Rask — UI Kit
